packageRules.description: Android build toolchain (Gradle, Android Gradle Plugin, Kotlin) must match what the framework supports: it moves with the framework upgrade, behind dashboard approval, never automerged
iOS toolchain (CocoaPods and the Ruby gems behind it): verify has no iOS build, so a person merges these after an iOS build

Flutter SDK pin (the exact environment.flutter in pubspec.yaml, which verify and the deploys use): its own PR, in which Renovate regenerates pubspec.lock on the new Flutter; dashboard approval, never automerged. Its own group, because an update waiting for approval holds its whole branch, and in the non-major group it held every routine update
Resolved from the Flutter SDK, not Maven: the lookup always fails
